name: intent
description: Help product managers write and publish intents without touching git — /intent-create interviews you and opens an issue, /intent-sync publishes your Word edits (warning first if the intent changed on GitHub), /intent-refresh rebuilds your Word file from GitHub, /intent-promote moves the intent to Ready for planning; planning locks an intent with lock.yaml in the-marmack/intents, and locked means locked, so a change is a new intent that supersedes it (/intent-create … supersedes <issue URL>); admins set up each PM's repo with /intent-repo-setup.

interface.shortDescription: Write, sync and promote PM intents in GitHub.
